units.source_text: 我也回到自己的房间，偶尔探望一下外面，

en.t: I also returned to my own room and occasionally looked outside,

units.source_text: 发现大竹七段动作麻利，转眼换上了棉袍，

en.t: and saw that Otake, seventh dan, moved briskly and had changed into a padded robe in no time,

units.source_text: 下到庭院，独自坐在对面的长凳上。

en.t: then gone down into the garden and sat alone on the bench opposite.

units.source_text: 他紧抱双臂，耷拉下苍白的脸。

en.t: He clasped his arms tightly and let his pale face droop.

units.source_text: 冬日临近黄昏，暮霭朦胧，

en.t: The winter day was nearing dusk, and the evening haze had grown dim,

units.source_text: 他在冷飕飕的宽阔庭院里，陷入了沉思。

en.t: as he sank into thought in the cold, spacious garden.
